claim: The EUR-Lex consolidated MDR PDF (CELEX 02017R0745-20250110) is freely downloadable and its Annex I section 23.2 lists label particulars (a) through (s), 23.3 sterile-packaging particulars, and Annex VI Part C defines the UDI system.
evidence: Downloaded the PDF from the exact URL offered (no login, HTTP 200, application/pdf, 1.8 MB, 233 pages) and extracted the text with pypdf. Page header reads "02017R0745 — EN — 10.01.2025 — 005.001", i.e. consolidated version of 10 January 2025 (amendments M1 Reg 2020/561, M2 Del. Reg 2023/502, M3 Reg 2023/607, M4 Reg 2024/568 listed on page 1). Annex I, Chapter III, section 23.2 "Information on the label" begins "The label shall bear all of the following particulars: (a) the name or trade name of the device ..." and runs through "(s) for active implantable devices, the serial number, and for other implantable devices, the serial number or the lot number." Section 23.3 "Information on the packaging which maintains the sterile condition of a device ('sterile packaging')" lists particulars (a) through (j) (sterile-packaging indication, sterile declaration, sterilisation method, manufacturer name/address, device description, clinical-investigation wording, custom-made wording, month/year of manufacture, use-by/implant time limit, damaged-packaging instruction). Annex VI is titled "Information to be submitted upon the registration of devices and economic operators ... core data elements to be provided to the UDI database ... and the UDI system"; its "PART C — THE UDI SYSTEM" starts with "1. Definitions" (AIDC, Basic UDI-DI, ...). Independently cross-checked against the EUR-Lex HTML rendering of the same CELEX number, which shows the same (a)-(s) list for 23.2 and (a)-(j) for 23.3 and the 10.01.2025 consolidation date. Note: 23.2(h) itself cross-references "Article 27(4) and Part C of Annex VI" for the UDI carrier. Caveat not verified: whether a newer consolidation than 20250110 exists as of 2026-10-18 (the EUR-Lex ALL page returned empty); the claim does not assert it is the latest, so this does not affect the verdict.
correction: No correction needed. For precision, citations can read: Regulation (EU) 2017/745, consolidated 10.01.2025 (CELEX 02017R0745-20250110), Annex I s.23.2 (a)-(s) label particulars; Annex I s.23.3 (a)-(j) sterile-packaging particulars; Annex VI Part C "The UDI system" (definitions of AIDC, Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, UDI-PI, UDI carrier, etc.). Consider also citing s.23.4 (instructions for use) and Article 27 (UDI system) since 23.2(h) cross-references them. Before the pitch, re-check EUR-Lex for any consolidation newer than January 2025.
impact_on_candidate: None negative: the claim holds in full, so the EU rule registry and judge-facing citations are sound. Minor residual risk only if a newer consolidated version has been published since 10.01.2025 and a judge expects the latest CELEX suffix; mitigated by citing the article/annex numbers (which are unchanged by the recent amendments) alongside the consolidation date.
